title: Olive and the Dark Clouds
checkpoint: Year 1 Autumn 1, week 2 — School readiness — Phase 5: new sounds ea, oy, ir
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 5 continues (School readiness), 92-sound stage (e-e, i-e just added).

pages.illustration: Olive the owl perched in the oak tree, looking up at thick dark clouds gathering.
Dark clouds rolling closer over the garden and pond.
Olive the owl swooping down towards the pond.
Several ducks paddling happily on the pond as the first drops of rain begin.

pages.text: Olive is not fond of rain.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl looking unimpressed as rain starts to fall around the pond.
Olive the owl tucked beneath a large broad leaf at the pond's edge.

pages.text: The rain taps on the leaf.
pages.illustration: Raindrops pattering steadily on the broad leaf sheltering Olive.
Olive the owl dry and comfortable beneath the sheltering leaf as rain falls outside.
Sunlight breaking through as the rain over the pond eases away.

pages.text: Olive flies out into the sun.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl flying out from under the leaf into warm sunshine over the pond.
